author: reek
body: Bounded signatures, stage A: the function boundary draws the same hybrid narrowing check as a record field. A literal argument proven within a bounded parameter reports CDX2053 (bounds check elided), and an argument proven in range by the interval analysis (an if-union) also elides. The unproven body-into-bounded-return shape is rejected since CDX2051 became an error; its twin lives in errors/narrowing-unproven. The sidecars pin the proven diagnostic and the in-range behavior.
